result.brief: 提出条件残差预测（CRP），让因果视频扩散模型减少对历史条件的依赖，无需双向教师即可提升自回归长视频生成质量。
result.reason: Causal autoregressive video diffusion training recipe (CRP) improving long/streaming video generation without bidirectional teacher; directly serves video generation and world-model-style autoregressive prediction.
